payload.note: Heat-bath influence symbol checkpoint: at free BT, K=(-Delta)^2 has K_oo=72. The simultaneous quotient-site conditional-mean response has tau(p)=1-omega(p)^2/72; its off-diagonal absolute row sum is 184/72=23/9 and checkerboard response is -23/9, so absolute Dobrushin contraction fails already free. The signed continuous-time mean generator has omega(p)^2/72 and the correct L^-4 slow scaling. The interacting response satisfies D_k m_o=-Cov(s,D_k S) and |D_k m_o|<=1/2 sqrt(E[(Hess S[h_o,k])^2]). A signed mixed-Hessian Fourier/multiscale estimate, global Poincare/Witten theorem, interacting H^-1 bound, continuum reconstruction, Born rule, Krein reconstruction, and Lorentzian transfer remain open.
